title: elytrigia bessarabica
intro: Elytrigia bessarabica, commonly known as Bessarabian wheatgrass, is a perennial grass species in the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Elytrigia bessarabica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Elytrigia bessarabica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
